notes: CONFLICT: Machenta stored $52000000 (2026-11-03), source says $40000000 seed co-led by Creandum and Union Square Ventures (Pulse 2.0, Sifted, Imperial, Business Insider, 2026-10-27). Groups 'machenta', 'imperial' and '11 person startup' are the same round and were merged into one row (group_key machenta). Merged groups: 'this startup' + 'mave' (Mave $34M incl. $28M Series A, Israeli); 'nine person halluminate' + 'finance' (Halluminate $30M Series A); 'hyperbolic' + 'backed by intels ceo'; 'rapidcanvas' + 'c2969951ade3'. Healthleap: $38M announced as two rounds; emitted two rows with the same group_key (Series A $30M led by Hummingbird Ventures; Seed $8M co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital). Merge may prefer to keep only the Series A row. Scuba: $34M across pre-seed (Accel) and seed (Accel + IVP co-lead); amounts not split so emitted one Seed row. Four Aussie startups round-up: Copy Geek and Forward Deployed already stored in rounds.json and not re-emitted; Metacognition AI amount not given in text (row has amount null). MP Space amounts are AUD. Round-type notes: Hyperbolic 'Series A-1' mapped to Series A; Easol 'Series A Extension' ($20M equity + $10M Viola Credit debt facility) mapped to Series A; Cognitive Credit 'strategic growth investment' mapped to Growth; Coast 'growth equity' mapped to Growth. Discrepancies seen: Watchtower Labs amount is $35M per company, $30M per co-lead Shield Capital's announcement; doxx.net Series A is $38M per press release but Dealroom cites $24.6M via Axios Pro; Coast lead 'Thomvest Ventures' comes only from a citybiz headline; Tolan lead disputed (one outlet says USV led, TechCrunch names no lead) so lead left empty; Enact Intelligence no lead named. HQ caveats: Duvo set to 'unknown' (press release datelined New York and London, The Recursive says Prague-based). Outmarket AI, Mach9, Vitalize, Vesta, Catalyst and Tolan set to US with no city because sources read did not state the city. Namespace (Zurich, CH), Easol (London, GB) and Bites website from prior knowledge, not from text. Resolved URLs for Bites (studybites.ai), Coast (ibm.com), Vesta (vestahws.com), Enact (training.enactmi.com), Vera Health (va.gov) and Mach9 (login page) were wrong pages and were not used as sources. Lookups used: 23 WebSearch calls, 0 WebFetch; no failures. Outmarket AI announced_date 2026-09-30 (Insurance Edge) rather than the 2026-10-05 Pulse 2.0 item.
